'''Obai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. At some point he became part of the [[Order of Revan]] and defected from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], joining with the Revanite forces on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. During the [[Battle of Rishi]] in [[3637 BBY]] he and a fellow Revanite [[Vodd]] tried to stop a strike team from reaching the signal jammer on the [[Razorback Island]], but failed and were killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Obai appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
